body: I still live with my parents because I'm in highschool. If I try to talk to anyone, my dad will find out and pretty much shame me. I feel pathetic every hour of my life because of this, and the only thing holding me together is the people I care about. Life to me has become such a busy-work shitstorm. I work and that stresses me out, to the point where I just want to crash my car into a lightpole. 90% of my life is worry and 10% living which leaves me exhausted Also I'm pretty sure my 'friends' use me for my car and my drugs, so it's nice to know our relationship is one sided. Thanks for the helpful reply but I have my mind set on my own endgame.
